case: A supersession whose derived closure contains an accepted outcome leaves it unreopened, and the guard passes it.
why: This is the counterexample computed against the four original conjuncts: derived_closure_refs = [an accepted outcome], reopened_acceptance_refs = [], closure_walk_completed = true. `subset([], [x])` holds, all four conjuncts hold, AND THE GUARD PASSES THE ADVERSE CASE 05 section 9 row 11 says must fail. The containment ran the wrong way -- a real guarantee, that the reopen set cannot be authored beside the walk, and a different one from the guarantee the row needs. The mutation removes the containment in the corrected direction, restoring exactly that.
